chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl ibn Ṣāliḥ, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the qunut, whether it is before the rukuʿ or after it. He said: Neither before it nor after it.

key_terms.الْقُنُوتِ: the qunut supplication performed in salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith in al-Istibsar say about performing qunut before or after rukuʿ?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling concerning the placement of qunut in salat (prayer). It presents a report from Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام in response to a question about whether qunut is to be performed before or after the rukuʿ.
